function.name: read_terminal
function.description: Read the in-app terminal pane beside this chat. No args = visible screen + total_lines; page scrollback with start_line (0 = oldest) + count. JSON: {total_lines, start, end, viewport_rows, cursor_row, text}.

start_line.description: 0-indexed first line (0 = oldest). Omit for the visible screen.

count.description: Lines to read from start_line. Defaults to the visible row count.
